verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner split with the bottle large on the left and the copy column on the right. Its flaws: the headline breaks onto a second line that holds only 'fizz', SOLSTICE is scaled up and sits under the headline where it competes with it, and the copy column is cramped against the top and right edges. B breaks the reading order: the CTA is at the top, the brand comes after the headline and the body copy is at the bottom. Its bottle shrinks to a tiny icon, so the key product image is lost, and the bottom copy runs into the canvas edge.
